g.title: j2314042326
g.text: u know every time i think i have the lil speedster figured out he goes n surprises me lmaooo

g.title: j56457297
g.text: How so?

g.title: j894513920
g.text: Is he mad about the packing peanuts?

g.title: j3426972941
g.text: [Ignore.]

g.title: j1700435041
g.text: sooo okay i blocked off the room w/ cardboard n cut a hole in it, used a shopvac on reverse to pump the room full of packing peanuts, yeah? gotta get that shit floor 2 ceiling

g.title: j218769279
g.text: ANYTHING BUT

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j915434360
g.text: I'm impressed.

g.title: j1995874666
g.text: You've clearly done this before.

g.title: j1911120429
g.text: life on an army base can get surprisingly boring sometimes, dunno what 2 tell u lol

g.title: j1021338986
g.text: so then it was 'shut the door n pull the cardboard out from under the door so when he opens it, all the shit pours out' ezpz

g.title: j3819807381
g.text: he comes over, all going as planned, goes 'huh my door's shut, that's weird.' opens the door. FRWOOMF

g.title: j1351113412
g.text: HE SCREAMS like a lil girl seeing a mouse, just goes up on one leg like anything, it was sooooo good

g.title: j582905625
g.text: n then he hears me laughin', and i figure that's when he's gonna get pissed. but then he starts LAAAUGHING

g.title: j3370457352
g.text: n he asks me how i did it! so i walk him through it. n the lil speedster's like... super impressed? asks 4 the cardboard i used. winds up taping off the lower half of his door, like a pen, yeah?

g.title: j3399969744
g.text: lil freakin' weirdo has turned his room in2 a packing peanut ball pit, like u'd find at the burger house. i found him in there just playin' in it with aoi, 2 of them just chuckin' it at each other like it was snow

g.title: j3629162229
g.text: they asked me if i wanted 2 join in

g.title: j3940645923
g.text: And did you?

g.title: j3262011243
g.text: Well?

g.title: j1019433267
g.text: PSH. me? Quincy-K?! Me?! the king himself? this smooth criminal? could u see me in there with them yutes?!

g.title: j3398046809
g.text: of COURSE i fkin' jumped in there!

g.title: j2204592471
g.text: wouldn't have done that b4 u showed up. none of it. so... yeah. thanks for helping me get the stick outta my arse

g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.text: next prank? arthur. ;)
